heading.en: The wicked take the truth to be hard—Lehi's sons marry the daughters of Ishmael—The Liahona guides their course in the wilderness—Messages from the Lord are written on the Liahona from time to time—Ishmael dies; his family murmurs because of afflictions. About 600–592 B.C.
heading.sm: E ave e e amioleaga le upumoni o se mea faigata—Ua faaipoipo atalii o Liae i afafine o Isamaeli—Ua taitai e le Liahona lo latou ala i le vao—Ua tusia i le Liahona savali mai le Alii mai lea taimi i lea taimi—Ua oti Isamaeli; ua muimui lona aiga ona o puapuaga. E tusa o le 600–592 T.L.M.

w.en: by the voice of the Lord,
